note: The find hard-limit: the emitter bakes LIMIT cap + 1 (visible in the vector statements) and the read boundary throws LimitExceededError post-fetch (assertFindHardLimit). The null-disable and explicit-LIMIT SKIP paths are exec vectors that must NOT throw.

vectors.name: guard: the read overruns findHardLimit → throw [sqlite]
vectors.case: guard: the read overruns findHardLimit → throw
